environment: Complete project, Edge/Chromium, two independent browser contexts, shared MVCC SDK test double; no live Firebase or Rules execution

results.name: Full CMS startup and Advertising legacy document
Seed creation race: exactly one transaction accepted
Stale category save cannot remove concurrent new category
Catalog update preserves unrelated metadata and all original IDs
Concurrent creates: conflict rejected, refreshed retry appends uniquely
Independent categories/languages allow concurrent creates
Concurrent reorder transactions: one conflict, no partial order
Add/reorder race cannot omit the added lesson
Stale lesson editor cannot overwrite concurrent edit
Move between scopes locks source and destination, appends
Cross-scope and partial reorder rejected without any commit
Offline failure before commit retains request ID; retry creates once
Lost commit acknowledgement: refresh and repeat return same ID, one document
Pending create ID survives page reload after lost acknowledgement
Successful UI save followed by read failure cannot duplicate on repeat
Corrupted catalog never replaces loaded snapshot; writes blocked
Permission-denied catalog read never becomes missing/seed
Corrupted lesson is not partially loaded or silently discarded
Actual Firestore ID overrides legacy data.id
Duplicate IDs, orphan parent, cycles, and wrong catalog types rejected
Depth 20 accepted; depth 21 and moved deep subtree rejected
UI cannot save a category below depth 20
Removing an existing category rejected transactionally
Populated category reparent rejected by adapter
Concurrent add vs empty-category move cannot orphan lesson
Delete serializes order and blocks stale reorder
Real YouTube parser: watch/Shorts/live/embed/unlisted-style URLs and negatives
UI creates a nested translated category and preserves existing taxonomy
Draft, hidden category, filters, arrow UI and mobile navigation regression
UI deletes an old empty category with named confirmation
UI prevents populated and parent category deletion
UI cancellation keeps category; deletes new translated child and clears editor
Repeat deletion with stale revision rejected
Quick Hide / Close / Open preserves all videos and category content
Quick close cancellation and duplicate click guard
Maintenance form save, reopen and parent restrictions
Stale availability edit rejected without overwriting latest status
Category controls stay within the mobile viewport
Spark build never imports the Cloud Functions SDK
Firestore map key order does not turn one status change into many changes
Promocodes UI generates only after confirmation, filters, exports and rotates universal code
Centered in-page generation dialog supports cancel and Escape without writing codes
Copy single and universal codes uses exact plaintext and preserves code state
Copy falls back on denied clipboard permission and reports only successful copy
Admin can cancel or reset an installation without resetting its consumed code
Reset of a universal installation preserves other installations and current universal code
Interrupted generation resumes the same code batch without duplicates
Actual admin repository generates 5000 unique codes in bounded transactions on fake backend
Five new codes are automatically selected, issued atomically and copied as five separate lines
Counters distinguish issued, remaining and activated; repeat group copy does not double count
Two admins cannot issue the same code twice; disabled and activated codes are rejected
Failed clipboard keeps issued group recoverable without issuing again
Phone navigation, forms, code actions and centered dialog fit 390 and 320 pixel widths
No unexpected JavaScript page errors
